description: This Java class 'SavingsAccountChargeDataValidator' provides validation methods for JSON data related to savings account charges, including adding, updating, and paying charges within the Fineract microfinance platform.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating JSON data related to savings account charges, including add, update, and pay charge operations.

methods.name: validateAdd
methods.description: Validates JSON input for adding a new savings account charge, checking for required fields and correct data types.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing savings account charge, including optional fields.

methods.name: validatePayCharge
methods.description: Validates JSON input for paying a savings account charge, ensuring amount and date are provided and valid.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors have been collected.
